error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot regrade. Regrading needs the evidence.regrade permission (owners, admins and instructors).
error.SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: You cannot regrade your own answer.
error.SECOND_REVIEWER_REQUIRED: You made the decision this would replace. A different person must regrade it.
error.APPEAL_OPEN: The learner asked for a second opinion. Decide it in the appeal queue first.
error.NOT_YET_REVIEWED: This written answer has no review yet. Review it in the review queue.
error.NOTHING_TO_REGRADE: There is no graded result to regrade on this attempt.
error.EVIDENCE_INVALIDATED: Staff already withdrew this attempt's evidence. A regrade does not restore it.
error.REGRADE_UNSUPPORTED: Placement and retention answers are not regraded here.
error.RUBRIC_CHANGED: The rubric changed since this answer was given.
error.RUBRIC_FINDINGS_REQUIRED: Give one finding for every criterion.
error.RUBRIC_CRITERIA_INCOMPLETE: Give one finding for every criterion.
error.RUBRIC_QUOTE_REQUIRED: Each criterion you mark as shown needs an exact quotation from the answer.
error.RUBRIC_DECISION_INCONSISTENT: The decision does not match the required criteria.
error.EVALUATOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: This host cannot run the item's evaluator now.
error.COURSE_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE: The course version this answer was given on is no longer stored.
error.ENROLLMENT_CLOSED: This enrollment is closed. Its record is not changed after closure.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A different request was already sent with this key. Reload and try again.
error.unavailable: The regrade could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
